name: DNS Query To AzureWebsites.NET By Non-Browser Process
description: Detects a DNS query by a non browser process on the system to "azurewebsites.net". The latter was often used by threat actors as a malware hosting and exfiltration site.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Likely with other browser software. Apply additional filters for any other browsers you might use.
query: dns.question.name:*azurewebsites.net AND (NOT ((process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe)) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe)) OR
